research_scope: DLC Parallel Quest skills from PQ 101-110, screened against the canonical skill index and prior research batches. Non-skill rewards excluded.

verification_audit.method: PQ numbering and reward identity reconciled against independent PQ reward references and the current DLC documentation. Exact drop probabilities were not inferred where sources did not establish them.

duplicate_screening.notes: Records already represented as canonical/indexed skills were not duplicated merely because they reappear in DLC reward lists.
